attributes.action: increase SSP to match minimum wage or 80% of it at the very least
attributes.additional_details: SSP should be inline with the national minimum wage or atleast 80% of its value, when working 40hrs a week you get £508.40 per week but if you are ill you are expected to survive on £123.25 which puts pressure on people to return to work before they are ready, there is also a very real chance of getting into serious financial hardship and if you are off for stress related reasons this could lead to people taking their own lives due to the financial stress and worry
attributes.background: I would like the UK Government to bring SSP inline with the national minimum wage or atleast 80% of its value, when working 40hrs a week you get £508.40 per week but if you are ill you are expected to be able to survive on £123.25 which put pressure on people to return to work before they are ready

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on what you are primarily asking for in your text. You may wish to sign it:

Minimum State Pension should equal the National Minimum Wage for under 18s
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775103
